author: Inside Edition
description: Police officers came to the rescue of a family whose car got carried away by flood water. It happened in Beeville, Texas. Police spotted the car and called out to the people inside, who informed them that one of the passengers was a baby. An officer waded into the water to make contact with the vehicle. Once there, the baby was handed over to him in a carrier and he brought the child to shore. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Rescue Baby From Car Swept Up In Floodwater During Storm

description: Pizza and bagels are the flavors of New York City, but some long-held recipes might have to change if a ban on a certain type of flour passes. Potassium bromate is a dough conditioner which reportedly strengthens gluten and speeds up fermentation, but it's already been banned in places like Canada and California because it's suspected to cause cancer. New York City dough makers are already experimenting with new recipes. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: NYC Pizza And Bagel Makers Prepare For Possible Ban On Popular Flour Additive
